items.title_zh: 狗狗身着节日服装参加 Ganesh Chaturthi 庆祝活动，互联网称“很开心”
items.title_en: Dog Joins Ganesh Chaturthi Celebrations In Festive Attire, Internet Says ‘Made My Day’
items.summary_zh: 在视频中，可以看到谢鲁 (Sheru) 盛装出席，以与人类一样的热情迎接甘帕蒂 (Ganpati)。
items.summary_en: In the video, Sheru, can be seen dressed for the occasion as he takes part in welcoming Ganpati with the same devotion as humans.
